data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 0.209m. During 2023 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding increased, with prior-year development indicating a gross strengthening of approximately GBP 0.095m (mainly relating to 2021). The report cites inflationary uncertainty and adverse claims development as relevant risk drivers, while reinsurance recoveries have materially offset net impact.
raw_causal_phrases: Reserving: At 2023 year end, MRSL adopted a cautious approach to reserving in recognition of the inherent uncertainty of forecasting inflationary impacts.
Rising inflation has an impact on insurers' claims costs, reserving, price adequacy, investment returns and capital modelling
Geopolitical uncertainty has continued to dominate the risk landscape.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not stated explicitly in a single narrative sentence. A gross claims development table was used to derive a prior-year strengthening of GBP 95k (0.095m) primarily from movements in the 2021 underwriting year. The claims development table layout in the PDF/parsed text is fragmented; numbers were interpreted from the cumulative claims rows. No explicit sentence describing gross prior year movement was found. LOB-specific reserve movements are not provided and therefore left unquantified.
